summary: Add host to pool prefills the joining host's address from what the host reports and shows the operator only the address; the scheme and port are composed in the client from the host's report.

guide.reason: Join step 4 now says the address is prefilled from the host's own report, that only a bare address is entered when it must change, and that an older host leaves the field empty.

api.reason: Additive: Core inventory gains managed.peer_origin (an observation; omitted when the host cannot work it out) and GET join-candidates gains peer_address and peer_port per candidate, with Core's default port for a host that reports none. POST join is unchanged. Documented in docs/API.md and the Controller OpenAPI contract; an older Controller ignores the inventory field and an older host simply reports none.

state.reason: The reported peer origin is a per-report observation the host recomputes every time and the Controller mirrors for display in the same stored-inventory column as the other per-host observations, never acting on it. The durable record stays what it was: the member's peer origin in the master's membership, written by the join itself.

verification.method: go test ./internal/agent/ -run TestReportCarriesOwnPeerOrigin (report carries the origin derived from the configured peer listener); go test ./internal/controller/ -run TestPoolJoinCandidates (no report gives an empty address and the default port; a reported origin gives its address and port); node web/src/pool-members.test.mjs (origin composition from address and port, refusal of pasted origins, ports, paths and credentials); .cache/phase1-qa-venv/bin/python tests/integration/site_selector_browser.py against the rebuilt web/dist in headless Chromium with route fixtures: selecting a fixture candidate prefills 192.0.2.56 and enables the confirm button, a pasted origin is refused with the address-only message, an empty address disables confirm; capture join-dialog-host-selected.png inspected. Not exercised against a real Controller with two enrolled hosts.
